$comment: The closed set of icon categories. A directory under icons/ that is not listed here is a validation error, and a listed category may legitimately be empty. Declaring the taxonomy rather than inferring it from the filesystem is what makes a typo'd directory ('navigaton/') fail loudly instead of silently becoming a new category. Category is browse metadata only — it is never part of an icon's export name, so moving an icon between categories is not a breaking change.
